数仓版集群ID。

description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters.

description.zh:
资源组名称。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBResourceGroup](~~612410~~)接口查看指定集群的资源组信息，包括资源组名称。
description.en:
The name of the resource group.

> Call the [DescribeDBResourceGroup](~~612410~~) operation to query information about the resource groups of a specific cluster, including the resource group names.

description.zh:
地域ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~143074~~)接口查看指定数仓版支持的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID.

> Call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the region IDs supported by AnalyticDB for MySQL.
